title: Chicken Caprese with Tomato, Mozzarella and Basil Oil
changes_from_base: Grilled chicken breast becomes the base, with tomato and mozzarella melted on top and a lemony basil oil in place of plain olive oil.
summary: Juicy grilled chicken breasts topped with charred tomato slices and softly melting mozzarella, finished with a bright lemon and basil oil.
equipment: small blender or pestle and mortar

ingredients.item: small boneless, skinless chicken breasts (about 650 g), pounded to 2 cm thick
fine sea salt or table salt
basil leaves, plus extra small leaves to serve
large ripe tomatoes, in 1 cm slices

steps.title: Make the basil oil
steps.text: Blend or pound the basil with the olive oil, lemon juice and garlic until bright green.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Season the chicken with salt and pepper and rub with 1 tbsp olive oil.

steps.title: Grill
steps.text: Heat the griddle until very hot. Cook the chicken 4-5 min per side until well marked and 74 °C in the centre. Briefly char the tomato slices for 1 min per side.

steps.title: Melt
steps.text: Top each breast with tomato and mozzarella, cover loosely with foil (or the barbecue lid) and leave 3-5 min until the cheese softens.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the basil oil over and scatter with small basil leaves.

tips: Pound the chicken to an even thickness so it cooks evenly.
Use a very hot pan for good grill marks.
The basil oil is also great on the plain Classic.
storage: Keep leftovers in the fridge for up to 2 days. Reheat until piping hot, or eat cold. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
